lines:
flowchart TD
    A[Adapter terminal timeout cancel crash or disconnect fact] --> B{Effect dispatch proven not started}
    B -- Yes --> C[FailedDefiniteNotStarted]
    C --> C1[RetrySafety eligible only for core workflow policy]
    B -- No --> D{Verifiable terminal result exists}
    D -- Yes --> E{Result kind}
    E -- Success --> F[Succeeded with usage artifacts and effect evidence]
    E -- Known failure after start --> G[FailedKnownStarted]
    E -- Confirmed cancellation --> H[CancelledWithEvidence]
    G --> I{Descriptor guarantees idempotency and same-id dedup}
    H --> I
    I -- Yes and evidence supports --> J[RetrySafety same invocation id only]
    I -- No or incomplete --> K[RetrySafety not safe]
    D -- No --> L{Effect absence positively proven}
    L -- Yes --> C
    L -- No --> M[OutcomeUncertain]
    M --> N[RetrySafety unknown or not safe]
    N --> O[Return control to core and workflow or user]
    K --> O
    J --> O
    C1 --> O
    F --> O
    P[Process health or kill alone] --> M
    Q[Unknown is never labelled safe to retry] --> N

data.title: Conservative Side-Effect Outcome and Retry Metadata Classification
